item.description:
Formula 0.1.70

  • Support: Formula sets things up in a customer's account (plan, approve, build, check), and conversations are ready before you open them (#136)
  • Ideas: an idea's builders and the pull request watcher take turns on a failed check (#137)
  • Ideas: planning and bug hunting run on the standard model; the strongest is kept for large ideas and retries (#135)
